items.title: Stalks of extension by zero along an etale morphism, and its exactness
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition computes the stalks of extension by zero along an etale morphism as the direct sum of the stalks of the given sheaf over the geometric points of the fibre, and deduces exactness of the functor (statement lines 11424-11435). The proof describes the stalk as a filtered colimit of sections of extension by zero (proof lines 11437-11448), unwinds the description of those sections as sums over the points of the fibre to obtain the direct sum formula (proof lines 11448-11460), and reads off exactness (proof lines 11460-11465). The non-formal content is the identification of the filtered colimit with the direct sum over the fibre. The claim is H2: one computation plus one consequence.
